note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Event v2 (sql/v2/45, 2026-10-27). Event counts RegTrack's Detailed Report 'Event Based' and 'Event Based Checklist' tabs: event-triggered compliance (Compliance.EventFlag = 1), one row per active due date in the report period, overdue = latest status Open and due before today. Rows are event types; EventID 0 = due dates with no event recorded. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Locations and compliance categories this user may see (EntitiesAssignment; location live and active).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#pairs') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #pairs;
SELECT DISTINCT ea.BranchID, ea.ComplianceCatagoryID AS CategoryId INTO #pairs
FROM EntitiesAssignment ea JOIN CustomerBranch cb ON cb.ID = ea.BranchID
WHERE ea.UserID = @UserID AND cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND cb.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.Status = 1;
-- Step 2. Event-triggered compliances there (Compliance.EventFlag = 1 - RegTrack's Event Based tabs):
--         compliance and Act not deleted, compliance visible, an active performer (ComplianceAssignment RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT ci.ID AS ComplianceInstanceID, ci.CustomerBranchID AS BranchID, c.ComplianceType, CAST(ISNULL(c.Imprisonment, 0) AS INT) AS Imprisonment INTO #inst
FROM ComplianceInstance ci JOIN CustomerBranch cb ON cb.ID = ci.CustomerBranchID
JOIN Compliance c ON c.ID = ci.ComplianceID JOIN Act a ON a.ID = c.ActID
JOIN #pairs p ON p.BranchID = ci.CustomerBranchID AND p.CategoryId = a.ComplianceCategoryId
WHERE cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND ci.IsDeleted = 0 AND c.IsDeleted = 0 AND a.IsDeleted = 0
AND (c.ComplinceVisible = 1 OR c.ComplinceVisible IS NULL) AND c.EventFlag = 1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceAssignment ca JOIN [User] u ON u.ID = ca.UserID
WHERE ca.ComplianceInstanceID = ci.ID AND ca.RoleID = 3 AND u.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND u.IsActive = 1 AND u.IsDeleted = 0);
-- Step 3. Their active due dates inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn), with the event type behind each
--         (EventScheduledOnID -> EventScheduleOn -> EventInstance.EventID; 0 when none is recorded).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#due') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #due;
SELECT cso.ID AS ScheduleOnID, i.ComplianceInstanceID, i.BranchID, i.ComplianceType, i.Imprisonment, cso.ScheduleOn,
ISNULL(CAST(ei.EventID AS BIGINT), 0) AS EventID INTO #due
FROM #inst i JOIN ComplianceScheduleOn cso ON cso.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
LEFT JOIN EventScheduleOn eso ON eso.ID = cso.EventScheduledOnID LEFT JOIN EventInstance ei ON ei.ID = eso.EventInstanceID
WHERE cso.IsActive = 1 AND cso.IsUpcomingNotDeleted = 1 AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd;
-- Step 4. Overdue due dates: the newest transaction (Dated, then ID) has status Open (1) and the due date is before today.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;
SELECT d.ScheduleOnID INTO #ovd FROM #due d
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 t.StatusId FROM ComplianceTransaction t WHERE t.ComplianceScheduleOnID = d.ScheduleOnID ORDER BY t.Dated DESC, t.ID DESC) lt
WHERE lt.StatusId = 1 AND d.ScheduleOn < CAST(@AsOf AS DATE);
